title: ctenium digitatum
intro: Ctenium digitatum, commonly known as the finger grass, is a type of tropical grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. The finger grass is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which help in wound healing and reducing the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Ctenium digitatum include its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
